blocks.text: Thermal physics hararat (heat), kaam (work), darja hararat aur tawanai ki doosri shaklon ke darmiyan talluq ka mutala hai. Thermodynamics ke qawaneen batate hain ke kisi nizam (system) mein tawanai kaise badalti hai aur nizam apne gird-o-pesh par mufeed kaam kaise kar sakta hai.

Bohat se atoms ya molecules wala bara nizam macroscopic system kehlata hai, aur aik atom ya molecule ka nizam microscopic system. Macroscopic nizam ki khasiyatein jaise darja hararat aur dabao (pressure) poore nizam ki hain aur molecules ka zikr kiye baghair parhi ja sakti hain. Microscopic nizam ki khasiyatein jaise kinetic energy aur momentum hain. Thermal physics bohat bari tadaad ke zarrat se kaam leti hai, Avogadro number ke darje ki: gases, liquids aur solids ke atoms ya molecules, balke metals mein electrons aur neutron stars mein neutrons bhi.

Gases ki kinetic theory ke rozmarra mein bohat se istemal hain, maslan gariyon ke engines, turbines, pumps, air conditioners, khurak ki tayyari aur mahol mein. Thermal physics gases ki kinetic theory aur statistical mechanics dono par mabni hai.

blocks.prompt: Macroscopic aur microscopic nizam mein kya farq hai? Har aik ki aik khasiyat batayein.
blocks.explanation: Macroscopic nizam mein bohat se atoms ya molecules hote hain (khasiyat: darja hararat ya dabao); microscopic nizam aik atom ya molecule hai (khasiyat: kinetic energy ya momentum).
